span.p:
Create names a VMID
Proxmox checks /vms/<vmid>

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Proxmox deletes that VMID's
ACL entry with the VM

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Next create on that VMID:
HTTP 403 Permission check failed

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Token granted VM.Allocate
and Pool.Allocate on
/pool/control-plane-lab

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Create names the pool
Proxmox checks /pool/<id>

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The pool is untouched —
it outlives the VMs in it

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Measured: eight of the hundred reserved identifiers were
consumed by one afternoon of verification runs. The failure
arrives after the control plane has already committed the
instance, the IPv4 lease and the quota slice.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pool.Allocate is separately required to add a VM to a pool.
Without it the create fails with
Permission check failed (/pool/control-plane-lab, Pool.Allocate).

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Membership is ignored after creation: bpg does not read it
back, so every later plan re-adds a VM already in the pool
and Proxmox answers HTTP 500 already a pool member.
